approved_scope.title: Keep finished sessions with open human gates open on session use/new, naming doctor's decision fix (#181)
approved_scope.description: Keep finished sessions with open human gates open on session use/new, naming doctor's decision fix (#181)
acceptance_criteria: A finished session (stage done, or native change finalized on HEAD) with a non-empty awaiting_human list stays open on session new and session use and is reported in kept_open with its open-gate count and a recovery: 'chough doctor --fix --reason <text>' when its native change is finalized, otherwise the checkpoint --close-gate command; a finished session without open gates is archived unchanged as before; the existing inbox-unfolded kept-open behavior is unchanged. Regression: a switch with one gated finalized session, one gated done session without a finalized change and one ungated finalized session archives only the ungated one, leaving the two gated sessions byte-identical.
